svg.text: Every count is from results.json, measured 2026-08-29 over bugzilla.mozilla.org's publicly visible record. “Triaged”, in Mozilla's own words, is a defect whose component is not UNTRIAGED and whose severity is neither -- nor N/A;

text.font-family: Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, Palatino, Charter, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: its policy asks for that within one week of filing. Security bugs are not visible to an unauthenticated reader and are not in this population.
